name: Stochastic Gaussian Splatting
definition: A stochastic method for rendering massive 3DGS scenes by sampling pixel-sized opaque points from Gaussians in view, splatting them via 64-bit atomics, and applying stochastic transparency to eliminate the need for sorting and tile-based rendering.
summary: Stochastic Gaussian Splatting renders massive 3D scenes by sampling opaque points and using atomic operations to eliminate sorting bottlenecks, enabling real-time display of hundreds of millions of Gaussians.
